jobs_results.title: (Senior) Devops Engineer – Blockchain Environment – Full Remote
Senior Engineer, DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Your mission

You, as a driven agile team member, will be working closely with the development teams to implement and support their continuous integration, in order to ensure stable and reliable releases of our platform. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining our container-based microservice infrastructure, to improve the availability and resilience of our services. With your motivation and knowledge in the latest cloud technologies, like Terraform and Kubernetes, you can create a scalable and solid architecture.

About the Team

The Platform area is responsible for developing and maintaining our internal APIs, services, infrastructure and security. The teams in the area support other Product teams by providing tools & services to enable the smoothest delivery possible of our Products. With a strong sense of ownership, you will ensure the timely and efficient delivery of high-quality code, a high level of performance and design whilst also developing innovative... compelling and cutting-edge systems that support our operations.

What you’ll do
• Development of our tools and improving systems and server setups to guarantee stability and security
• Collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance our system and develop new features
• Enhancement of our terraform codebase and infrastructure pipeline to support rapid feature delivery
• Monitoring and upgrading our systems and server setups to guarantee stability and security
• Mentor junior team members

Who you are
• Possess strong expertise in Cloud and AWS-based infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, SQS, etc.).
• Have a minimum of 3 years of experience with Docker, Kubernetes/ECS, and Terraform.
• Demonstrate proficiency in CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, Travis CI, Bitbucket Pipelines, or similar.
• Showcase experience in building and maintaining real-time application monitoring and deep knowledge of troubleshooting hotspots.
• Exhibit familiarity with languages like Bash, Python and Golang. Kafka knowledge is preferred

jobs_results.title: File-Service DevOps Expert in Workplace Services
jobs_results.description:
Are you an experienced DevOps professional with a passion for automation and a drive to deliver seamless workplace services? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Workplace Services (WPS) department at Allianz Group as a File-Service DevOps Expert.

As part of our Workplace DevOps Team, your main responsibility will be to drive the automation of service delivery and migration processes. Working closely with our WPS product teams, you will collaborate to successfully meet their automation goals. This role also involves supporting the agile transformation of the department and maintaining a mindset that keeps automation at the forefront of your daily activities.

You will:
• Plan, develop, test, and deploy our automation platform, primarily written in Python, to provide our services to Allianz employees worldwide.
• Maintain an application built by an external company on Kubernetes, including deployment, automating updates and bug fixes, and configuration of the... application itself.
• Discuss new requirements with experts on the customer side and drive their implementation.
• Support the design and implementation of File-Service components according to the architecture roadmap.
• Collaborate with expert teams in Workplace Services for the exchange of best practices and process management training.

Your skills:
• Completed degree in computer science or a comparable qualification.
• Expert knowledge in Python Coding
• Expert knowledge in working with Kubernetes.
• Advanced knowledge in working with Microsoft Azure.
• Advanced knowledge in automated testing.
• Advanced knowledge in working with CI/CD pipelines.
• Basic knowledge in working with SQL.
• Basic knowledge in technologies like Windows Server, Filesystems (DFS-R, DFS-N)
• Experience in Agile Work environments and corresponding tools and methods (preferably SCRUM)
• Self-oriented working, prioritization capabilities and the ability to cope under stress.
• Curiosity about modern technologies and interest in intercultural cooperation.
• Good spoken and written English skills.
• Professional experience for several years.

Your benefits:
• We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
• We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
• From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
• Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

About Allianz Technology

Allianz Technology is the global IT service provider for Allianz and delivers IT solutions that drive the digitalization of the Group. With more than 13,000 employees located in 22 countries around the globe, Allianz Technology works together with other Allianz entities in pioneering the digitalization of the financial services industry.

We oversee the full digitalization spectrum – from one of the industry’s largest IT infrastructure projects that includes data centers, networking and security, to application platforms that span from workplace services to digital interaction. In short, we deliver full-scale, end-to-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age.

D&I statement

Allianz Technology is proud to be an equal opportunity employer encouraging diversity in the working environment. We are interested in your strengths and experience. We welcome all applications from all people regardless of gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, age, nationality, religion, disability, or philosophy of life.

Join us. Let´s care for tomorrow.

You. IT

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $2B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva OpenData supports the industry by providing real-time reference data across the complete healthcare ecosystem... to support commercial sales execution, compliance, and business analytics. We drive value to our customers through constant innovation, using cloud-based solutions and state-of-the-art technologies to deliver product excellence and customer success. The OpenData Global Data Tools team delivers the tools and data processing pipelines used to build the global data core for life sciences in 100+ countries.

As a DevOps engineer contributing to the Global Data Tools team, you will manage the cloud system architecture and provisioning of cloud resources. You will also define the templates to configure CI/CD pipeline runs, build container agents, interconnect distributed resources, and apply security patches. You will promote and develop DevOps practices in the OpenData team.

This is a Work Anywhere position – you can choose to work remotely, or in one of our offices. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status for this position and you must already hold legal work authorization without needing an employer’s support.
What You'll Do
• Design, provision, and manage cloud computer clusters and storage solutions using Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code over AWS resources
• Manage the CI/CD tooling and the integration with other company resources in the cloud
• Manage containers, repositories, and container orchestrators in AWS
• Define data processing pipelines deployment and execution through source code and CI/CD (Pipelines as Code)
• Maintain source, container, and artifact repositories
• Apply security patches to AWS resources
• Being the DevOps evangelist
Requirements
• 3+ years experience as a DevOps engineer for a data processing platform
• Proficient in “Pipeline as Code” definitions in a DevOps platform such as GitLab or Git Hub
• Experience modeling system infrastructure in the cloud with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Terraform
• Previous experience delivering containerized deployable platform resources over Kubernetes in AWS
• Previous cloud experience provisioning and patching EC2 instances and managing network connectivity for groups of resources in AWS
• Shell and python script development skills
Nice to Have
• Experience managing GitLab pipelines and runners
• Hands-on experience with one or more configuration management tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet
• Experience using DevOps tools to deploy and administer clusters in a managed Apache Spark platform in the cloud (e.g., Databricks, AWS EMR)
Perks & Benefits
• Benefits package including Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), family health insurance, and contributions to private pension plans
• Annual allocations for continuous learning, development & charitable contributions
• Fitness reimbursement
• Work anywhere

#RemoteSpain

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at

talent_accommodations@veeva.com
.

Remoto

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURE

We’re currently seeking a DevOps Engineer to help our team on their next adventure. You will join an international and successful team and will report to the Tech Lead.

Your daily adventure :
• Administrate our cloud infrastructure in AWS and private cloud. Suggest improvements to the current setup.
• Provide technical guidance and educate team members on best practices in operations.
• Monitor metrics, provide observability to our infrastructure components and perform security audits.
• Define how to automate processes as well as deployment tasks. Own the deployment process to both internal and production environments.
• Set up CI / CD pipelines and educate the development teams to enforce a DevOps transformation.
• Update the DevOps processes for environment management including infrastructure, platform, and application lifecycle.
• Develop and document administration standards and procedures for internal and first-line support operations.
•... Periodically offer round-the-clock third-line support of the production environments, as part of a rotating on-call duty.

Qualifications

YOUR SKILLS

Are you serious about fun? Do you consistently seek out learning opportunities and aim to beat your high score? Are you open to new ideas, perspectives and cultures and believe that it takes a world to build a world?

At Ubisoft, you’ll work alongside passionate and talented teams who are imagining the future of entertainment.
• 2+ years’ experience as DevOps or equivalent.
• Strong experience with Linux-based infrastructures and AWS Cloud.
• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code best practices and tooling like Terraform.
• Docker and Kubernetes knowledge is a must.
• Experience with infrastructure automation.
• Experience with operations in a microservices architecture.
• Experience with CI / CD tools.
• Knowledge of Groovy and Bash.
• Be a team player : we use agile development methods, where the team members are in permanent contact. Open mind and good communication skills are a must.
• Attention to detail, meticulous and organized working habits. Ability to multi-task and to adapt easily to change.
• Should be open for on call duty.
• Fluency in written and spoken English.
• Work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is a must.

Bonus :
• Knowledge of Configuration as Code best practices.
• Knowledge of other Cloud providers like GCP or Azure is a plus.
• Knowledge of Python is a plus.
• Passion for games and some knowledge of the games industry.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Math, or related field. Master’s degree in any of these disciplines is a plus.
• Spanish or Catalan is a plus

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (Open to remote)
jobs_results.description:
SAVANA (www.savanamed.com) is an award-winning, international medical company aiming to accelerate health science by putting into the hands of healthcare providers the power to unlock all of the clinical value embedded within existing Electronic Health Records (EHRs) with Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing. Always ensuring maximum privacy and security.

Founded in 2014, Savana is an international medical company that has developed a scientific methodology that applies Artificial Intelligence (AI) to unlock all the clinical value embedded within Electronic Health Records' free-text (EHRs). With the largest AI-enabled, multi-language, multi-center research network in the world, Savana generates customized descriptive and predictive, High-quality Deep Real World Evidence research studies. Engineered by doctors for doctors, the company is built following the highest privacy-by-design standards.

Savana operantes in more than 160 hospitals, 5 languages, 15 countries... and has already improved more than 6 clinical practices with more than 100 employees from 16 nationalities. It constitutes a clinical research ecosystem that aims to advance personalized and precision medicine worldwide.

DevOps Engineer at Savana

Savana is looking for a DevOps Engineer to play a key and exciting role in our fast-growing company, serving Spanish, English, German and French speaking markets. Based remontly in Spain, he/she will participate on the challenging project of expanding Savana worldwide as well as serving our home market, Spain.

Major Accountabilities where this role is involved:
• Create secure, scalable, and reliable infrastructure.
• Actively participate in the software development lifecycle, offering infrastructure insights and solutions.
• Work on ways to automate and improve development and release processes.
• Ensure infrastructure is up and running according to business requirements.
• Participate in the design and architecture of efficient infrastructure solutions.
• Follow and enforce technical guidelines and best practices in Agile methodologies.
• Operate according to Security Policies, Procedures and Manuals.
• Proactively report potential incidents and suggest improvements.

Skills, Experience and Qualifications required:
• Proven experience in cloud infrastructure systems, particularly AWS, with an emphasis on secure and resilient design. 3-5 years of previous experience in a similar role.
• Good understanding of modern software architectures, including Microservices.
• Expertise in build and deployment automation.
• Advanced coding skills in Python / BASH.
• Advanced knowledge in networking and computer security principles.
• Experience working under SCRUM/Agile methodologies.
• Assertive, pragmatic, and fast learner with excellent problem-solving capabilities.
• Proficiency in English.
• Proactive and quality driven oriented.
• Team oriented with good interpersonal skills.
• Flexible working attitude open to changes.
• Ability to work in a multinational, multidisciplinary and fast-growing environment.

If you are practical, experienced, proactive, independent, articulate, passionate about facilitating the digital transformation of healthcare, fascinated by Artificial Intelligence, the future of medicine and determined to solve healthcare's biggest problems. You are a Savaner. Join us!

We offer:
• Work with a multidisciplinary team of clinicians, computer engineers, computational linguists, mathematicians, designers, medical Natural Language Processing expert programmers and other disciplines. We are a team of professionals with a common goal: to blend the knowledge of all of us to seek excellence in our purpose. Coming from very different disciplines, we want everyone to learn from everyone, creating a unique entity that moves towards the transformation of health through Artificial Intelligence.
• An opportunity to provoke a positive impact. We seek to improve health on the planet through technology and to help people and health institutions. Our employees and collaborators strive to provide our users with the necessary tools and support to achieve a more accessible and egalitarian global health. We care about our environment and we are willing to improve it.
• An environment to express yourself as you are and enjoy what you know. We defend individuality to form a richer and more plural "ecosystem". Be yourself and tell us what you have learned and how could we use it together to help us achieve our purpose. If you like what you do, we like to work with you.
• Competitive salary conditions, flexible culture and a development framework to growth your career. People are our main asset, so we invest in training and development and recognize and compensate for achievements and valuable work. We trust in the talent and commitment of people and focus on objectives and results, so we are flexible in our way of working, providing a framework to reconcile our personal and professional lives.

Details from this job description are not to be used for marketing purposes. Savana does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Savana via e-mail, the Internet or directly without a valid written search agreement will be deemed the sole property of Savana, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Savana.

Medsavana S.L. (“Medsavana”) will process the personal data you provide to us during the selection process (the “Candidate’s Personal Data”) in order to manage your curriculum data and the selection process you are applying to. You can exercise the rights of access, rectification or erasure, restriction of processing, objection, portability, and to object automated individual decisions at the registered office of the company indicated or in the email dpo@savanamed.com. For more information, please refer to the privacy policy section on our webpage: https://www.savanamed.com/es/curriculum

SAVANA (www.savanamed.com) is an award-winning, international medical company aiming to accelerate health science by putting into the hands of healthcare providers the power to unlock all of the clinical value embedded within existing Electronic Health Records (EHRs) with Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing. Always ensuring maximum privacy and security.

Founded in 2014, Savana is an international medical company that has developed a scientific methodology that applies Artificial Intelligence (AI) to unlock all the clinical value embedded within Electronic Health Records' free-text (EHRs). With the largest AI-enabled, multi-language, multi-center research network in the world, Savana generates customized descriptive and predictive, High-quality Deep Real World Evidence research studies. Engineered by doctors for doctors, the company is built following the highest privacy-by-design standards.

Savana operantes in more than 160 hospitals, 5 languages, 15 countries... and has already improved more than 6 clinical practices with more than 100 employees from 16 nationalities. It constitutes a clinical research ecosystem that aims to advance personalized and precision medicine worldwide.

DevOps Engineer at Savana

Savana is looking for a DevOps Engineer to play a key and exciting role in our fast-growing company, serving Spanish, English, German and French speaking markets. Based remontly in Spain, he/she will participate on the challenging project of expanding Savana worldwide as well as serving our home market, Spain.

Major Accountabilities where this role is involved:
• Create secure, scalable, and reliable infrastructure.
• Actively participate in the software development lifecycle, offering infrastructure insights and solutions.
• Work on ways to automate and improve development and release processes.
• Ensure infrastructure is up and running according to business requirements.
• Participate in the design and architecture of efficient infrastructure solutions.
• Follow and enforce technical guidelines and best practices in Agile methodologies.
• Operate according to Security Policies, Procedures and Manuals.
• Proactively report potential incidents and suggest improvements.

Skills, Experience and Qualifications required:
• Proven experience in cloud infrastructure systems, particularly AWS, with an emphasis on secure and resilient design. 3-5 years of previous experience in a similar role.
• Good understanding of modern software architectures, including Microservices.
• Expertise in build and deployment automation.
• Advanced coding skills in Python / BASH.
• Advanced knowledge in networking and computer security principles.
• Experience working under SCRUM/Agile methodologies.
• Assertive, pragmatic, and fast learner with excellent problem-solving capabilities.
• Proficiency in English.
• Proactive and quality driven oriented.
• Team oriented with good interpersonal skills.
• Flexible working attitude open to changes.
• Ability to work in a multinational, multidisciplinary and fast-growing environment.

If you are practical, experienced, proactive, independent, articulate, passionate about facilitating the digital transformation of healthcare, fascinated by Artificial Intelligence, the future of medicine and determined to solve healthcare's biggest problems. You are a Savaner. Join us!

We offer:
• Work with a multidisciplinary team of clinicians, computer engineers, computational linguists, mathematicians, designers, medical Natural Language Processing expert programmers and other disciplines. We are a team of professionals with a common goal: to blend the knowledge of all of us to seek excellence in our purpose. Coming from very different disciplines, we want everyone to learn from everyone, creating a unique entity that moves towards the transformation of health through Artificial Intelligence.
• An opportunity to provoke a positive impact. We seek to improve health on the planet through technology and to help people and health institutions. Our employees and collaborators strive to provide our users with the necessary tools and support to achieve a more accessible and egalitarian global health. We care about our environment and we are willing to improve it.
• An environment to express yourself as you are and enjoy what you know. We defend individuality to form a richer and more plural "ecosystem". Be yourself and tell us what you have learned and how could we use it together to help us achieve our purpose. If you like what you do, we like to work with you.
• Competitive salary conditions, flexible culture and a development framework to growth your career. People are our main asset, so we invest in training and development and recognize and compensate for achievements and valuable work. We trust in the talent and commitment of people and focus on objectives and results, so we are flexible in our way of working, providing a framework to reconcile our personal and professional lives.

Details from this job description are not to be used for marketing purposes. Savana does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Savana via e-mail, the Internet or directly without a valid written search agreement will be deemed the sole property of Savana, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Savana.

Medsavana S.L. (“Medsavana”) will process the personal data you provide to us during the selection process (the “Candidate’s Personal Data”) in order to manage your curriculum data and the selection process you are applying to. You can exercise the rights of access, rectification or erasure, restriction of processing, objection, portability, and to object automated individual decisions at the registered office of the company indicated or in the email dpo@savanamed.com. For more information, please refer to the privacy policy section on our webpage: https://www.savanamed.com/es/curriculum

At Thales, we are looking for an experienced, innovative and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our team and help us manage our development environment and improve our software development process. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in developing, deploying, and maintaining cloud and hybrid applications.The successful candidate should be a highly organized, detail-oriented professional with a passion for problem solving and a commitment to technological innovation. We are looking for an individual with a strong technical background in DevOps methodologies, Azure Cloud, scripting, and a strong understanding of software development processes. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of success in the deployment and maintenance of cloud applications.We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and is able to effectively manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously. The successful candidate should possess excellent... verbal and written communication skills, as well as the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. The ideal candidate will also be highly motivated, eager to learn, and possess the ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and processes.The successful candidate must possess the following qualifications:• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in DevOps engineering or a related field• Expert knowledge of DevOps methodologies• Extensive experience in the deployment and maintenance of cloud applications• Proficiency in Azure Cloud, scripting and software development processes• Strong technical background in development, deployment, and maintenance of cloud and hybrid applications• Excellent verbal and written communication skills• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment• High level of motivation and eagerness to learn• Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and processesIf you think you have what it takes to join our team, we would love to hear from you!

Thales is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics
